text: Great service and very professional staff. The clinic is clean and modern, and the dentist is gentle and attentive. I’m very satisfied with the results. Highly recommended!

STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE!! I am filing a complaint to the Thai Dental Council.

I walked in for a cleansing and scaling. The dentist scratched my teeth really hard and recommended me do a filling on a premolar and i did. When i went home I found one of my front teeth was chipped and the teeth still had coffee stain (which is the reason why i clean my teeth every 6 months).

I called the clinic. The staff did not speak English and the doctor refused to talk to me. They claimed she would call back but she never did. Long story short. We chatted on LINE and they blamed my teeth easy to break because of “demineralization”. I told them their dentist should have been gentle or at least tell me she broke my tooth when it happened, then offer a solution to fix it. They never addressed my issue. In the beginning they said it can be fixed with filling, and then said filling is not the solution as i need to remove some of my tooth to do that. They never confirmed an appointment for me to check my condition. They said they need to charge for the filling.

I have never seen any dentist or clinic like this in all the countries i have lived in. I work in the dental industry in Thailand and was shocked about my experience.

Our chat is in the photos. STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE IF YOU CARE ABOUT YOUR TEETH.

FYI - I've attached an email from GoWabi which is clearly unethical in every way, from a professional and personal standpoint. I refuse to be intimidated by empty threats to change my reviews just because the company is at fault. Once again, NOT COOL MSDC (& GoWabi)! Go find someone else to bully

UPDATED REVIEW (06/01/2025)

Thanks so much for your reply. Firstly, I don't appreciate how unprofessionally you started in the writing of your response, i.e. no "thank you for your review" and apology for the unacceptable situation.

Secondly, I completely understand that languages can be a barrier (I know this firsthand) and I had/have no issues with that whatsoever. However, there's no excuse for trying to dishonestly squeeze more money out of a customer in any language.

FYI - you and I know very well that the package that I had purchased from GoWabi clearly included teeth scaling, fluoride coating and a dental checkup. I knew full well that the filling was not included in the GoWabi package and accepted the price of THB 800 for that accordingly.

Finally, after receiving your response, I wish it was possible to give MSDC a negative 5-star (-5) review, but Google Maps doesn't allow for that, therefore I've just changed it from 2 stars to 1.

ORIGINAL REVIEW (05/01/2025)

Thanasarn Mahasaranont (ธนสาร มหาศรานนท์) is a good dentist for a Thai practitioner. I would have given MSDC 5 stars but they cheekily kept trying to scam me by asking me to pay more than I needed to. This insulted my intelligence and I didn't appreciate their forceful attitude.

I used a GoWabi voucher and they wanted me to sign a form stating that I'd pay for additional costs when I had already paid for everything. How unprofessional!

Because of this, I've actually decided to NEVER go back to MSDC & will recommend that my contacts go elsewhere for any dental work #toogreedy #whatashame
